_comment: Generic Google Cardboard v2 (the 2015 'Cardboard I/O' viewer) profile, as Google publishes it for viewer manufacturers: https://support.google.com/cardboard/manufacturers/answer/6321873 -- screen to lens 39.3 mm, inter-lens 63.9 mm, tray to lens 35 mm, k1 0.33582564, k2 0.55348791, 60 deg each way, BOTTOM alignment. A DIFFERENT headset needs its own profile; this one is not a measurement of Ty's. ipdM, renderScale, the chromatic-aberration scales and hudMode are ours, not Google's.
